name: Sparkilo
tagline: Find the cheapest fuel and EV charging near you
description:
Sparkilo helps you find the cheapest fuel and EV charging nearby, using real-time official prices across 17 countries. It can plan routes with the best stops along the way, alert you when prices drop, and even keep a trip logbook of your fuel consumption and costs by connecting to your car's OBD2 port along with GPS.

It's open-source, free of ads, and doesn't require creating an account, so your driving and location data stays yours.
